snippet.title: exA-Arcadia『あすか120%エクサレント』| Asuka 120% BURNING Fest. EXALLENT for Arcades | Attract Video
snippet.description:
Asuka 120% BURNING Fest. EXALLENT for Arcades on exA-Arcadia
Available Now

Players: 1-2
Genre: Fighter
Monitor: Horizontal (Recommended), Vertical
Languages: English, Japanese

FEATURES

ALL NEW SEQUEL
Asuka 120% finally returns with an all new installment based upon past fan favorites

14 PLAYABLE CHARACTERS
Choose from 14 unique characters hailing from every installment in the series

NEW GRAPHICS
Newly animated special moves and backgrounds

5 SOUNDTRACKS
EXALLENT - the all new soundtrack by Keishi Yonao
LIMITED - the Saturn soundtrack
FINAL - the soundtrack from the last installment on PlayStation
BURNING REMIXES Side A - the arranged soundtrack featuring guest composers Shinji Hosoe, Raito & more
BURNING REMIXES Side B - the arranged soundtrack produced by Super Sweep Records

TRAINING MODE
Practice battle situations against any character. Setup the CPU to do tech recoveries or give yourself maximum resources to go for the best combos!

AVAILABLE FOR THE FIRST TIME IN ENGLISH
Each character has a different story sequence and endings.

0.3 FRAME INPUT LAG RESPONSE – The fastest benchmark in the game industry
Maximum Performance! Play like you’re meant to. Never miss a combo again.

LEARN MORE ➡️ https://bit.ly/4pP1f4S
SUBSCRIBE ➡️ https://www.youtube.com/@exa-arcadia?view_as=subscriber?Sub_Confirmation=1
